python3 - <<'PY'
import json,collections
cards=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
a[4]['letters']='n';a[4]['errors'].append('missing_word_or_span');a[4]['detail']='Second printed copy of the line → ∅'
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for d in a:f.write(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(a)==len(cards)
assert [d['card_id'] for d in a]==[c['card_id'] for c in cards]
assert len(set(d['card_id'] for d in a))==len(a)
for d in a:
 assert all(k in d for k in ['card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where'])
 assert d['letters'] in ['y','n','u'] and d['marks'] in ['y','n','na'] and d['crop_ok'] in ['y','n']
 assert set(d['owner_crop'])=={'one_central_line','text_ne_visible_line','other_complete_line','gt2_whole_neighbour_words','turned_or_clipped'}
 assert all(v in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for v in d['owner_crop'].values())
print('Count and order verified:',len(a))
for k in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:print(k,dict(collections.Counter(d[k] for d in a)))
print('Errors:',collections.Counter(e for d in a for e in d['errors']).most_common())
PY
